additional_info.body:
Hello Chloe,
I will be taking over this ticket.
Based on the V2G logs, the issue appears to be that the charger is unable to communicate with the car. This could be due to a problem with our SECC, but it might also be related to the plug itself.
Do you know if the plug is clean? Dust or debris can interfere with communication. In general, would it be possible to get some pictures of the plug to check if there’s any visible damage or issues with the housing?
In the meantime, I have restarted the Docker container for the SECC controller.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen/ Best regards,Francois WINCKEL

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0435497-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / P8 170000766] Plug connection issue CRM:02919000102
additional_info.body:
Hi Francois
I went to Destelbergen this morning to test the charger.
You can find the photos attached. I created a WeTransfer link for the videos:
https://we.tl/t-SSIgblb8gz
When I arrived, there was a customer standing there trying to charge his EV. It failed to start a charging session on both plugs. I asked him to go to the other charger.
I put my EV on the charger in question to test for myself. indeed it failed to start a session. We gave the charger a soft reboot. Once the charger came back online, I was unable to start a charging session on plug 1, I did succeed on plug 2.
After successfully starting a charging session on plug 2, I tried again on plug 1. This time it worked.
This issue has been dragging on for some time but does not occur permanently. Sometimes it works, sometimes it doesn't.
The contactors on this charger [170000766] were already replaced last year in August. Could this be the cause again?
Met vriendelijke groeten | Cordialement | With kind regards,
